title: Kirkland Signature Japanese Style Maryland Marinated Chicken Pack $7.99 + Delivery ($0 w/ DashPass) & Fees @ Costco via DoorDash
body:
Deal: Kirkland Signature Japanese Style Maryland Marinated Chicken Pack $7.99 + Delivery ($0 w/ DashPass) & Fees @ Costco via DoorDash

[Lizard Spock] I didn't know Kirk and Mary had so much land.
[payton] Mary had leveled up, last I heard she just had a little lamb.
[payton] he got placed in middle management too, what a power couple!
[TEER3X] Not related to this deal but I had a missing item and couldn't get a refund.
I should've checked everything because it was the first time I had to provide a pin.
Previously never had any issues with door dash, but it looks like too many people abused their generosity in the past, now everyone pays for it.
[darkkito] talk to a live agent or ask them to call. the automated system sometimes will deny it.
[Ozbargainasaurus] Same boat. I talk to live chat, no dice.
[jno] Pretty average, wouldnt bother eating it again
[darkkito] agreed, its okay if you have nothing and an easy feed or meal prep but nothing beyond usual.
[danishcookie] warning - was charged full price in final invoice. I dont recommend it as its pretty average anyways.
[CDG] A$14.79/kg • Approx 0.54 kg per package
The price shown is an estimate. It will be updated after the order is completed at the store
[xhxxyx] i saw that as well, but the title says 1.2kg.. must be a listing error
[CDG] it's just tracky
7.99 per pack - Approx 0.54 kg per package
A$14.79/kg- then if the whole box is 1kg, u need to pay 14.79 when arrived. mean approx 2 package
[xhxxyx] I do agree with you that there’s no guarantee.
However, if you look at a regular item like lamb cutlets, the pack is 1.3 kg and priced at $70.84. That price is calculated based on $54.49/kg × 1.3 kg.
The item description probably shows the correct price, but the listed price must be incorrect.
[donman92] Set it to buy the chicken on Monday wish me luck!
